name: Dashboard / admin
looksLike: a website for managing users and records
a private screen with metrics tables and settings
an internal tool for updating business data
definition: An application interface for monitoring information and managing records, users, or settings. It prioritizes frequent tasks and accurate state over promotional storytelling.
goal: Help authorized users monitor status and complete management tasks.

sections.name: Workspace navigation
sections.purpose: Make sections, account context, and search easy to find.

sections.name: Overview
sections.purpose: Summarize the current status and important exceptions.

sections.name: Records and actions
sections.purpose: Let users find records and act on the right selection.

sections.name: Edit and feedback
sections.purpose: Explain validation, confirm risky actions, and report outcomes.

mustHave: Clear loading empty and error states

prompts.short: Build an admin dashboard with navigation, status summaries, searchable records, and safe editing.
prompts.detailed: Build a dashboard / admin website for staff and account administrators. Help authorized users monitor status and complete management tasks. Include workspace navigation, overview, records and actions, edit and feedback. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear loading empty and error states.
